claims.text: Input clarification ensembling factors an LLM's predictions into separate aleatoric and epistemic terms when aleatoric uncertainty arises from input ambiguity or under-specification.

evidence.description: The approach uses a mathematical decomposition similar to the one employed by Bayesian neural networks to separate uncertainty terms based on generated input clarifications.

methodologies.name: Input clarification ensembling
methodologies.description: Generates a set of clarifications for an input, feeds them into a pre-trained LLM, and ensembles the corresponding predictions to decompose total uncertainty.

limitations.text: Identifying sources of uncertainty in large language models remains an open research question.
The framework specifically targets aleatoric uncertainty arising from ambiguity or under-specification in LLM inputs.
